title: Hyperparameter Tuning Techniques: Grid & Random Search and Bayesian Optimization

cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today, we're talking about hyperparameter optimization techniques.
cues.zh: 今天談超參數最佳化技術。

cues.en: So let's say we have hyperparameters a and b.
cues.zh: 假設有超參數 a、b。

cues.en: We're going to look at three methods of optimizing them: a grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimization.
cues.zh: 看三種方法：網格搜尋、隨機搜尋、貝氏最佳化。

cues.en: Now we're not going to go into the details and the mathematics and algorithms and so on, especially for Bayesian optimization.
cues.zh: 不深入細節、數學與演算法，尤其貝氏最佳化。

cues.en: But at the same time, we'll just get an overview of how they work so we know the differences.
cues.zh: 先概觀運作，知道差別。

cues.en: Okay, so the first one is grid search.
cues.zh: 第一是網格搜尋。

cues.en: So this is what it looks like.
cues.zh: 長這樣。

cues.en: I'm just going to, first, we're going to understand what we're looking at here.
cues.zh: 先理解眼前圖形。

cues.en: So this is hyperparameter a and hyperparameter b.
cues.zh: 這是 a 與 b。

cues.en: And so just for argument's sake, we've assumed they're from 0 to 1.
cues.zh: 假設都從 0 到 1。

cues.en: Each one of them is plotted from 0.
cues.zh: 每個從 0 畫起。

cues.en: Well, it has ranges from 0 to 1.
cues.zh: 範圍是 0 到 1。

cues.en: And this is a two-dimensional projection of a three-dimensional plot.
cues.zh: 這是三維圖的二維投影。

cues.en: So if you imagine three dimensions, the third dimension is basically what we're optimizing.
cues.zh: 想像第三維，就是要最佳化的值。

cues.en: So let's say we are optimizing R squared, we're looking for the best model with the best R squared.
cues.zh: 例如 R 平方，找 R 平方最佳模型。

cues.en: So blue represents the height of that third dimension, in this case R squared.
cues.zh: 藍色表示第三維高度，這裡是 R 平方。

cues.en: So this darkest blue means it's the highest, and then goes down, and red means the lowest.
cues.zh: 最深藍最高，再往下降，紅色最低。

cues.en: So this is very bad model performance, the R squared is almost 0.
cues.zh: 這裡模型很差，R 平方幾乎 0。

cues.en: This is very good, the R squared is almost 1.
cues.zh: 這裡很好，幾乎 1。

cues.en: This is also pretty good.
cues.zh: 這裡也不錯。

cues.en: So this is also bad.
cues.zh: 這裡很差。

cues.en: And so, what grid search does, is you see these little x's?
cues.zh: 網格搜尋會做什麼？看到小叉號嗎？

cues.en: Well, that's basically what we did.
cues.zh: 就是每次測試。

cues.en: We take hyperparameter a, and we specify a grid.
cues.zh: 取 a，指定網格。

cues.en: We say, okay, so hyperparameter a, we know it's between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 知道介於 0、1。

cues.en: We're gonna start from, let's say here, in this case it's about 0.05 with a step of 0.1.
cues.zh: 從這裡大約 0.05，步長 0.1。

cues.en: 0.45, .55, et cetera, up to 0.95.
So we specify that that's the range for parameter a.
cues.zh: 這是 a 範圍。

cues.en: And for hyperparameter b, we're specifying, I guess similar in this case, but it doesn't have to be the same thing.
cues.zh: b 這裡類似，但不必相同。

cues.en: It can be something, some other values, you can just specify exact values which you want.
cues.zh: 可用其他值，直接指定想要的確切值。

cues.en: They don't have to be equidistant from each other or as in, like, they don't have to be for certain step.
cues.zh: 不必等距、不必固定步長。

cues.en: But in this case, it's 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, et cetera, up to 0.95.
And then, what the algorithm will do for you is it will actually just test out all the possible combinations.
cues.zh: 演算法測全部可能組合。

cues.en: So as we can see, every one of these x's is a test that the algorithm ran.
cues.zh: 每個叉號就是一次測試。

cues.en: So, and then out of all of them, it'll return the best one.
cues.zh: 從中回傳最佳。

cues.en: So maybe the best one here is this one or this one, or might be one of these ones.
cues.zh: 也許這個、這個，或這些之一。

cues.en: See, it didn't get to the final, the actual maximum, but it got very close.
cues.zh: 沒到實際最大值，但很接近。

cues.en: So you get one of these and as a result, it'll tell you what the hyperparameter was.
cues.zh: 取得其中之一，回報超參數。

cues.en: So in the case, let's say this one was the best one.
cues.zh: 假設這個最佳。

cues.en: Hyperparameter a was 0.35.
Hyperparameter b was 0.45.
And it'll tell you what the R squared was.
cues.zh: 再告訴你 R 平方。

cues.en: So that's grid search.
cues.zh: 這是網格搜尋。

cues.en: Now, if we take a random search and apply it to the same problem, basically you specify what range you want a and b to be in.
cues.zh: 相同問題用隨機搜尋，只需指定 a、b 範圍。

cues.en: And then, you just let the algorithm randomly choose a certain number of combinations from there and see which best result it comes up with.
cues.zh: 讓演算法隨機選一定數量組合，找最佳結果。

cues.en: So here, you can see we got lucky and it was able to find this one, and it'll return that as the value of the a and b hyperparameters and the R squared for that.
cues.zh: 這裡運氣好找到這個，回傳對應 a、b 與 R 平方。

cues.en: And then finally, if you use Bayesian optimization, it's actually smarter.
cues.zh: 最後貝氏最佳化更聰明。

cues.en: What it does, it combines exploration and exploitation.
cues.zh: 結合探索與利用。

cues.en: It randomly searches at the start.
cues.zh: 一開始隨機搜尋。

cues.en: And then, as soon as it finds something like I would say it's found this one, this one's quite good, it keeps exploring around that area.
cues.zh: 找到不錯的點，例如這個，就繼續探索附近。

cues.en: And then, it find, oh, this one's even better, it keeps exploring around that area and it keeps finding better ones.
cues.zh: 找到更好點，再探附近，不斷改善。

cues.en: But also, at the same time, occasionally does random ones to see, to make sure it's not stuck in a local minimum.
cues.zh: 同時偶爾也隨機探索，確認沒困在局部最小值。

cues.en: Let's say if this was a local minimum and this one was even better.
cues.zh: 假設這是局部最小值，而另一個更好。

cues.en: Hypothetically, let's say this was even better, then instead of just like going straight to this place and like only checking these values here, it's still going to do random ones
cues.zh: 假設那個更好，就不能只走到這裡、只查附近，仍會隨機測試，

cues.en: and might find the better one.
cues.zh: 可能找到更好。

cues.en: But in this case, this is the best one.
cues.zh: 但這個例子，這裡最佳。

cues.en: And I guess you can see it's doing quite a good job coming here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它很成功地來到這裡。

cues.en: So yeah, so that's how Bayesian optimization works.
cues.zh: 這就是貝氏最佳化的概觀。

cues.en: Well, and again, we're not going into detail here.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，不深入細節。

cues.en: The goal here was to get an overview of these three methods and their differences.
cues.zh: 目標是理解三種方法與差異。

cues.en: On that note, I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
